analysis: The stretch started strong — 29 July through 31 July you were building beautifully, peaking at just over 8 hours with nearly 47 minutes of deep sleep and your awake time barely registering. Then something shifted: the back half of this week has been hovering in the sixes and low sevens, with that 6h 30m night in the middle being the obvious low point. Your REM has actually been impressively consistent across all seven nights, sitting between 1h 33m and 1h 48m almost every single night, which tells me your nervous system is doing something right — whatever ritual stack you're running is clearly landing somewhere. The gap is total duration and getting more of that deep sleep back, because you had 54 minutes of it on 2 August which proves your body knows how, it just needs you to give it enough runway to get there.
